**Associated manuscript: Diagnosing miscalibration in multistate models**

We present calibration plots for every scenario. Section 1 is for non-updated models, and section 2 is for updated models.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
### Define t
t_in <- 5
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
### Create counter for Figure numbers
fignum <- 1

### Create number of scenarios for dgm
scenarios_per_dgm <- c(40, 6, 8, 10)

### Loop through whether model updated or not
for (model_updated in 1:2){
  
  cat(paste0("\n\n# ", 
             c("Calibration plots", 
               "Calibration plots for updated models after data distribution shifts")[model_updated], "\n\n"))
  
  ### Loop through DGMs
  for (dgm in 1:4){
    
    cat(paste0("\n\n## DGM-", dgm, "\n\n"))
    
    cat(paste0("![](Figure_1_DGM", dgm, ".png){width=80%}\n\n"))
    
    ### Loop through scenarios and paste Figures
    for (scenario in 1:scenarios_per_dgm[dgm]) {
      
      ### Read in data.frame with the simulation inputs
      sim_inputs <- readRDS(paste("../data/sim_inputs_dgm", dgm, ".rds", sep = ""))
      
      ### Extract development and validation scenario numbers
      devel_num <- as.numeric(sim_inputs[scenario, "devel_num"])
      valid_num <- as.numeric(sim_inputs[scenario, "valid_num"])
      
      ### Get figures name
      if (model_updated == 1){
        fig_name  <- paste0("../figures/calib_plot_comb_DGM",dgm,"_s",scenario,"_t",t_in,".png")
      } else if (model_updated == 2){
        fig_name  <- paste0("../figures/calib_plot_comb_model_updated_DGM",dgm,"_s",scenario,"_t",t_in,".png")
      }
      
      ### Print sub-title for validation scenario group (conditional) and Figure
      if (dgm == 1){
        
        # Scenario group
        if ((scenario - 1) %% 8 == 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n\n### Validation scenario V",  dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                     c("Equal to development", 
                       "shift in transition 1->2", 
                       "shift in transition 1->3",
                       "shift in transition 2->3", 
                       "shift in all transitions")[valid_num], ")", "\n\n"))
        }
        
        # Figure title
        cat(paste0("\n\n**Figure S", fignum, ": DGM ", dgm, "; Development scenario D", dgm, ".", devel_num, " (",
                   c("exponential", "weibull")[ceiling(devel_num/4)], " hazard, ",
                   c("baseline parameters equal across transitions", 
                     "faster transition 1->2", 
                     "faster transition 1->3", 
                     "faster transition 2->3")[((devel_num - 1) %% 4) + 1], "); ", 
                   "Validation scenario V", dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                   c("Equal to development", 
                     "shift in transition 1->2", 
                     "shift in transition 1->3",
                     "shift in transition 2->3", 
                     "shift in all transitions")[valid_num], ")",
                   "**\n\n"))
      } else if (dgm == 2){
        
        # Scenario group
        if ((scenario - 1) %% 2 == 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n\n### Validation scenario V",  dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                     c("shift in transition 1->2", 
                       "shift in transition 1->4", 
                       "shift in transition 2->3")[valid_num], ")", "\n\n"))
        }
        
        # Figure title
        ### Print Figure num
        cat(paste0("\n\n**Figure S", fignum, ": DGM ", dgm, "; Development scenario D", dgm, ".", devel_num, " (",
                   "weibull hazard, ",
                   c("baseline parameters equal across transitions", "different baseline scale parameters out of state 1")[devel_num], "); ", 
                   "Validation scenario V", dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                   c("shift in transition 1->2", 
                     "shift in transition 1->4", 
                     "shift in transition 2->3")[valid_num], ")",
                   "**\n\n"))
      } else if (dgm == 3){
        
        # Scenario group
        if ((scenario - 1) %% 2 == 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n\n### Validation scenario V",  dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                     c("shift in transition 1->2", 
                       "shift in transition 1->4", 
                       "shift in transition 2->3", 
                       "shift in transition 2->4")[valid_num], ")", "\n\n"))
        }
        
        # Figure title
        cat(paste0("\n\n**Figure S", fignum,": DGM ", dgm, "; Development scenario D", dgm, ".", devel_num, " (",
                   "weibull hazard, ",
                   c("baseline parameters equal across transitions", "different baseline scale parameters out of state 1")[devel_num], "); ",
                   "Validation scenario V", dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                   c("shift in transition 1->2", 
                     "shift in transition 1->4", 
                     "shift in transition 2->3", 
                     "shift in transition 2->4")[valid_num], ")",
                   "**\n\n"))
      } else if (dgm == 4){
        
        # Scenario group
        if ((scenario - 1) %% 2 == 0) {
          cat(paste0("\n\n### Validation scenario V",  dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                     c("shift in transition 1->2", 
                       "shift in transition 1->4", 
                       "shift in transition 2->3", 
                       "shift in transition 2->4", 
                       "shift in transition 3->4")[valid_num], ")", "\n\n"))
        }
        
        # Figure title
        cat(paste0("\n\n**Figure S", fignum, ": DGM ", dgm, "; Development scenario D", dgm, ".", devel_num, " (",
                   "weibull hazard, ",
                   c("baseline parameters equal across transitions", "different baseline scale parameters out of state 1")[devel_num], "); ",
                   "Validation scenario V", dgm, ".", valid_num, " (",
                   c("shift in transition 1->2",
                     "shift in transition 1->4", 
                     "shift in transition 2->3",
                     "shift in transition 2->4", 
                     "shift in transition 3->4")[valid_num], ")",
                   "**\n\n"))
      }
      
      ### Print figures
      cat(paste0('![](', fig_name,  '){width=100%}\n\n'))
      
      cat("---\n\n")
      
      ### Add 1 to figure numbers
      fignum <- fignum + 1
    }
  }
}

```
